title: “A Heartbeat Away” | The Role Of The US Vice President
speaker: Alastair Budge

sentences.en: Hello, hello hello, and welcome to English Learning for Curious Minds, by Leonardo English.
sentences.zh: 大家好，欢迎收听由 Leonardo English 出品的英语学习播客《English Learning for Curious Minds》。

sentences.en: The show where you can listen to fascinating stories, and learn weird and wonderful things about the world at the same time as improving your English.
sentences.zh: 在这个节目中，你可以聆听精彩的故事，了解世界上奇妙而有趣的事情，同时提升你的英语水平。

sentences.en: I'm Alastair Budge, and today we are going to be talking about American politics.
sentences.zh: 我是 Alastair Budge，今天我们要聊聊美国政治。

sentences.en: On November 5th, as anyone who has not recently emerged from a self-imposed period of isolation in a cave will know, the United States voted to re-elect Donald Trump as President.
sentences.zh: 正如任何近期没有在一个山洞里与世隔绝的人所知，11月5日，美国投票重新选举唐纳德·特朗普担任总统。

sentences.en: But we aren’t going to be talking about that, or at least the US election isn’t going to be the focus of this episode.
sentences.zh: 但我们不会聊这个，或者说美国大选不会是本期节目的焦点。

sentences.en: Instead, we are going to talk about the role of the vice president of the United States.
sentences.zh: 相反，我们将探讨美国副总统的职责。

sentences.en: We’ll look at what the Vice President actually does, how the role has evolved over time, and why this vice president might just be one of the most influential ones in American history.
sentences.zh: 我们将看看副总统实际上做些什么，这个职位是如何演变而来的，以及为什么这位副总统可能会成为美国历史上最有影响力的副总统之一。

sentences.en: OK then, let’s get right into it, and talk about Vice Presidents.
sentences.zh: 好了，废话不多说，我们直接切入正题，聊聊副总统。

sentences.en: In the hit political drama, House of Cards, the Machiavellian protagonist, Frank Underwood, hatches a plot to become President.
sentences.zh: 在热门政治剧《纸牌屋》中，善于权谋的主角弗兰克·安德伍德密谋成为总统。

sentences.en: Through a mixture of political manipulation, blackmail, and dealmaking, he manages to become Vice President.
sentences.zh: 通过政治操纵、勒索和交易的组合拳，他成功当上了副总统。

sentences.en: He uses this as a position to weaken the sitting president, his boss, and then claim the top job for himself.
sentences.zh: 他利用这个职位削弱现任总统——也就是他的老板，然后把最高职位据为己有。

sentences.en: He seems to be on top of the world but makes a fatal miscalculation by choosing as his Vice President his equally ruthless wife.
sentences.zh: 他似乎登上了权力之巅，却犯下一个致命的误算，选择了他同样冷酷无情的妻子作为副总统。

sentences.en: I won’t ruin any more of the story for those of you who have never watched it, but all I will say is that while the vice presidency seems to Frank to be a supporting, semi-powerless role, it proves to be anything but.
sentences.zh: 对于那些没看过这部剧的人，我就不剧透更多了，我只想说，虽然对弗兰克来说副总统似乎只是一个辅助性的、没有什么实权的职位，但事实证明它远非如此。

sentences.en: If you haven’t ever watched House of Cards, I would highly recommend it.
sentences.zh: 如果你没看过《纸牌屋》，我强烈推荐。

sentences.en: Of course, it is fictional, so dramatic it seems hard to believe at times, but it is not unrealistic in its depiction of the route from Vice President to President of the United States.
sentences.zh: 当然，它是虚构的，戏剧化到有时让人难以置信，但在描绘从副总统到美国总统的晋升之路时，它并不脱离现实。

sentences.en: To be precise, out of the 46 individuals who have held the role of President of the United States, 15 of them–1 in 3–were previously Vice Presidents, or VPs, as they are more commonly known.
sentences.zh: 准确地说，在担任过美国总统的46个人中，有15个人——即三分之一——此前曾担任副总统，也就是通常所说的 VP。

sentences.en: And now is a particularly interesting time to talk about the Vice President.
sentences.zh: 现在是讨论副总统的一个极其有趣的时刻。

sentences.en: Last month, the sitting Vice President Kamala Harris lost her bid to succeed Joe Biden and become the 16th person to transition from Vice President to the Oval Office.
sentences.zh: 上个月，现任副总统卡玛拉·哈里斯竞选接替乔·拜登失败，未能成为第16位从副总统入主椭圆形办公室的人。

sentences.en: Even the fact that she ran for president was a matter of contest.
sentences.zh: 甚至她竞选总统这件事本身也饱受争议。

sentences.en: Her president, Joe Biden–himself a former Vice President–had pulled out of the race over questions about his age and mental agility, and there were commentators who complained that she had become the Democratic presidential nominee almost by default, that there hadn’t been a proper leadership contest.
sentences.zh: 她的总统乔·拜登——他本人也曾是副总统——因对其年龄和精神敏捷度的质疑而退出了竞选，一些评论员抱怨说，她几乎是在不战而胜的情况下成为民主党总统候选人的，并没有经过真正的党内领导权竞争。

sentences.en: And, on the Republican side, it is an interesting time to talk about the role of the Vice President because when Donald Trump is inaugurated, on January 20th 2025, he will be 78 years and 220 days old, half a year older than Joe Biden was at his inauguration.
sentences.zh: 而在共和党这边，讨论副总统这个角色也正当其时，因为当唐纳德·特朗普于2025年1月20日就职时，他将年满78岁零220天，比乔·拜登就职时还要大半岁。

sentences.en: Assuming that he finishes his four-year term, he will be almost 83 years old.
sentences.zh: 假设他完成为期四年的任期，他将接近83岁。

sentences.en: No matter your opinion about Donald Trump, his politics and his character, there is no denying that this makes him an old man, and makes the choice of who would replace him, were he unable to complete his term, all the more important.
sentences.zh: 无论你对唐纳德·特朗普的看法、他的政治观点和性格如何，不可否认的是，这使他成了一位老人，这也使得万一他无法完成任期时由谁来接替的选择变得更加重要。

sentences.en: As you will know, there have been several presidents who have died in office, 8 to be precise.
sentences.zh: 正如你所知，曾有几位总统在任内去世，确切地说是8位。

sentences.en: Of these 8 presidents who died in office, all of them were at least 10 years younger than Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 在这8位死于任上的总统中，他们都比唐纳德·特朗普至少年轻10岁。

sentences.en: And yes, you might point out that of those 8 who died in office, half were assassinated, so it has nothing to do with age.
sentences.zh: 是的，你可能会指出，在这8位死于任上的总统中，有一半是被暗杀的，所以这与年龄无关。

sentences.en: But the counterpoint to this is that there have been at least two assassination attempts on Donald Trump in the past year alone.
sentences.zh: 但反驳的观点是，仅在过去的一年里，针对唐纳德·特朗普的暗杀未遂事件就至少发生了两次。

sentences.en: So there are a few factors meaning that there is an even greater reason to pay attention to the person who is “a heartbeat away” from the Presidency.
sentences.zh: 因此，有几个因素意味着，我们有更大的理由去关注那个距离总统宝座“仅一步之遥”的人。

sentences.en: This is, of course, the main role of the Vice President.
sentences.zh: 这当然也是副总统的主要职责。

sentences.en: In the event of the President’s death, the Vice President automatically becomes President.
sentences.zh: 一旦总统不幸去世，副总统将自动继任总统。

sentences.en: No debate, no election, the Vice President becomes President for the remainder of the President’s term in office.
sentences.zh: 无需辩论，无需选举，副总统将担任总统直至剩余任期结束。

sentences.en: But let’s assume that Donald Trump does serve out his term in office.
sentences.zh: 但我们假设唐纳德·特朗普确实完成了他的任期。

sentences.en: He cannot run for President again; the 22nd Amendment, which states that a President can serve a maximum of two terms, prevents this from happening.
sentences.zh: 他不能再次竞选总统；规定总统最多只能连任两届的《宪法第二十二修正案》阻止了这种情况的发生。

sentences.en: And before there are murmurs about how this Amendment could be overturned, and Donald Trump’s throwaway comments about running for a third term, it would be immensely difficult for this to happen, and to my knowledge, no serious commentator has ever entertained this as a possibility.
sentences.zh: 在有人小声议论这个修正案如何被推翻、以及唐纳德·特朗普关于竞选第三任期的随口言论之前，要让这种情况发生是极其困难的，而且据我所知，没有哪个严肃的评论员会把这当成一种可能。

sentences.en: Donald Trump will not be able to run for President in 2028, and this will be his last term.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普将无法在2028年竞选总统，这将是他的最后任期。

sentences.en: And the betting markets already have a clear favourite for who will be the next President; JD Vance, Trump’s VP, his pick for Vice President.
sentences.zh: 博彩市场已经对下一任总统有了明确的预测人选：万斯，特朗普的副手，他挑选的副总统人选。

sentences.en: As of last week, so months before he will assume the Vice Presidency, betting sites are suggesting that JD Vance has a 40% chance of being elected President in 2028.
sentences.zh: 截至上周，也就是他将就任副总统的几个月前，博彩网站显示万斯在2028年当选总统的几率高达40%。

sentences.en: He is young, charismatic, the natural successor to Donald Trump, and he has the next four years to appeal to the American public and demonstrate his abilities in a way that Kamala Harris did not.
sentences.zh: 他年轻、极具个人魅力，是唐纳德·特朗普的自然接班人，并且他有接下来的四年时间来吸引美国公众，并以卡玛拉·哈里斯没有做到的方式展示自己的能力。

sentences.en: That’s the reason to talk about the Vice Presidency today.
sentences.zh: 这就是今天我们要讨论副总统的原因。

sentences.en: It is, potentially, more important than ever before.
sentences.zh: 它可能比以往任何时候都更加重要。

sentences.en: So, what does the Vice President actually do, other than assume the duties of the President if they die or are incapacitated?
sentences.zh: 那么，副总统除了在总统死亡或丧失履职能力时承担总统职责之外，实际上还做些什么呢？

sentences.en: Well, it’s a bit of a cop-out answer, but it really depends.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这个回答有点在打擦边球，但真的要视情况而定。

sentences.en: The Vice Presidency is a strange sort of role – one that can be incredibly powerful, or practically irrelevant, depending on the President and the political landscape at the time.
sentences.zh: 副总统是一个奇怪的职位——根据当时的总统和政治格局，它可以拥有难以想象的权力，也可以几乎毫无足轻重。

sentences.en: In theory, it’s an essential part of American democracy, a safeguard to ensure continuity of government.
sentences.zh: 从理论上讲，它是美国民主不可或缺的一部分，是确保政府延续性的安全网。

sentences.en: In practice, though, it’s a position that’s evolved in fascinating and, sometimes, contradictory ways.
sentences.zh: 但在实践中，这个职位却以迷人且有时甚至是矛盾的方式发展着。

sentences.en: When the role of Vice President was first created, it was almost an afterthought.
sentences.zh: 当副总统这个职位最初设立时，它几乎是一个事后才想到的补充。

sentences.en: Originally, the Vice President wasn’t chosen by the President or running as part of a team, as they are today.
sentences.zh: 最初，副总统不是由总统挑选的，也不是像今天这样作为竞选搭档参选。

sentences.en: Instead, the candidate who came second in the Presidential election automatically became Vice President.
sentences.zh: 相反，在总统选举中获得第二名的候选人自动成为副总统。

sentences.en: This often meant that the President and Vice President could be political opponents with very different ideas.
sentences.zh: 这意味着总统和副总统往往是政治观点截然不同的政敌。

sentences.en: Imagine, for example, Donald Trump having Kamala Harris as his Vice President—or vice versa.
sentences.zh: 试想一下，比如唐纳德·特朗普让卡玛拉·哈里斯当他的副总统——或者反过来。

sentences.en: Not surprisingly, the Founding Fathers didn’t envision the Vice President as a powerful figure.
sentences.zh: 毫不奇怪，开国元勋们并没有把副总统设想为一个有权有势的人物。

sentences.en: Since the role went to the runner-up, it wasn’t intended to hold much influence.
sentences.zh: 既然这个职位落到了第二名头上，它本来就没打算拥有多大影响力。

sentences.en: To reduce the chances of two rivals ending up in office together, the process was changed 25 years later with the 12th Amendment in 1804.
sentences.zh: 为了减少两个政敌最终同时上台的可能性，25年后的1804年，通过第十二修正案，这一流程被更改了。

sentences.en: This amendment established that people would vote for the President and Vice President as a pair, much like they do today.
sentences.zh: 该修正案规定，人们将像今天一样，把总统和副总统作为一个组合来投票。

sentences.en: Since then, the Presidential candidate has chosen a running mate who might appeal to a particular segment of the population—maybe younger voters, women, people from specific backgrounds, or voters in key electoral states.
sentences.zh: 从那时起，总统候选人会选择一个能够吸引特定选民群体的竞选搭档——比如年轻选民、女性、特定背景的人，或是关键摇摆州的选民。

sentences.en: But what does the Vice President actually do?
sentences.zh: 但副总统究竟做些什么呢？

sentences.en: Constitutionally, what is their role? Well, partly as a hangover from when the role was created, there are only two mandated functions.
sentences.zh: 从宪法上讲，他们的职责是什么？嗯，部分由于该职位创立时的历史遗留问题，宪法规定的职能只有两项。

sentences.en: If there was a job description, it would only have two “must do” items on it.
sentences.zh: 如果要写一份工作职责，上面大概只有两项“必须要做”的事。

sentences.en: The first is, as we’ve said, to act as a backup for the President, to step up if the President is incapacitated or dies.
sentences.zh: 第一项，正如我们所说，是做总统的后备力量，在总统丧失履职能力或去世时顶上去。

sentences.en: And the second is to preside over the Senate and cast a tie-breaking vote when needed.
sentences.zh: 第二项是主持参议院工作，并在需要时投出打破僵局的关键一票。

sentences.en: As a quick recap of how the American government works, there are three branches: the Executive, which is the President, the House and the Senate.
sentences.zh: 简单回顾一下美国政府的运作方式，它分为三个分支：行政分支，也就是总统；众议院和参议院。

sentences.en: The Vice President has particular responsibility over the Senate, in that they have the deciding vote in the event of a tie.
sentences.zh: 副总统对参议院负有特定职责，即在出现平局时拥有决定性的一票。

sentences.en: The US has 50 states, each with two Senators, so there are 100 seats in total.
sentences.zh: 美国有50个州，每个州有两名参议员，所以总共有100个席位。

sentences.en: If there is a vote on an issue and it is a tie, it is 50 votes for and 50 votes against, the VP casts their vote to decide the outcome.
sentences.zh: 如果某个议题的表决结果是平局，也就是50票赞成、50票反对，副总统就要投出决定性的一票来打破僵局。

sentences.en: Perhaps it sounds unlikely, but it happens a lot.
sentences.zh: 这听起来或许不太可能，但其实经常发生。

sentences.en: To date, there have been 301 times that a VP has been required to do this, and because the Senate was divided 50-50 after the 2020 Senate elections, Kamala Harris’s vote became incredibly important.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，副总统需要行使这项职责的情况已经出现了301次，而且由于2020年参议院选举后参议院势均力敌，Kamala Harris的投票变得极其重要。

sentences.en: As of the time of writing this, she has cast 33 tie-breaking votes, making her the most influential VP in American history from a Senate legislation point of view at least.
sentences.zh: 截至本文撰写之时，她已经投下了33次打破僵局的关键票，至少从参议院立法的角度来看，这使她成为美国历史上最具影响力的副总统。

sentences.en: So, the VP is important when it comes to tie-breaking votes, but what else do they spend their days doing, when they don’t have to cast votes and the President’s heart is beating normally?
sentences.zh: 所以，副总统在打破僵局的投票中非常重要，但除此之外，当他们不需要投票且总统心脏还在正常跳动时，他们平时都在做些什么呢？

sentences.en: Well, especially in the early days of the Vice Presidency, there was very little else, and certainly very little in the way of the day-to-day running of the country.
sentences.zh: 嗯，特别是在副总统制度刚建立的早期，几乎没有什么别的事可做，更谈不上参与国家的日常运转了。

sentences.en: This was famously summed up by the first Vice President, John Adams, who is reported to have said that the Vice Presidency was “the most insignificant office that ever the invention of man contrived.”
sentences.zh: 首任副总统John Adams对此曾有过一句名言，据报道他说副总统是“人类发明过的最微不足道的职位”。

sentences.en: And, for quite a while, he was right. Vice Presidents, including Adams himself, were often kept at arm’s length by Presidents and largely excluded from major decision-making.
sentences.zh: 而且，在相当长的一段时间里，他说得没错。副总统们，包括Adams本人，常常被总统敬而远之，在很大程度上被排除在重大决策之外。

sentences.en: It was seen as a job for those who'd either failed to win the presidency outright or who needed to satisfy a particular political faction within the government.
sentences.zh: 当时这被视为一份给那些竞选总统失败、或者需要用来安抚政府内部某个特定政治派别的人准备的工作。

sentences.en: Fast forward a century or two, and things started to change.
sentences.zh: 快进一个世纪或两个世纪，情况开始发生变化。

sentences.en: Throughout the 20th century, the Vice Presidency gradually morphed into a position with real influence.
sentences.zh: 在整个20世纪，副总统职位逐渐演变成一个具有真正影响力的职位。

sentences.en: Under Franklin D. Roosevelt, for example, Vice President Harry S.
sentences.zh: 例如，在富兰克林·D·罗斯福任内，时任副总统哈里·S·

sentences.en: Truman became deeply involved in wartime decision-making, a relationship that would prove crucial when Roosevelt’s sudden death thrust Truman into the role of Commander-in-Chief in 1945.
sentences.zh: 杜鲁门深度参与了战时决策，这种关系在后来罗斯福突然去世、杜鲁门于1945年接任三军统帅时被证明至关重要。

sentences.en: Then, in 1967, the 25th Amendment was ratified, clarifying what should happen if a President died or became incapacitated, and formally establishing the line of succession.
sentences.zh: 接着，在1967年，《美国宪法第二十五修正案》获得批准，澄清了总统去世或丧失履职能力时应采取的程序，并正式确立了总统继承顺位。

sentences.en: This amendment also allowed Presidents to fill the Vice Presidency if it became vacant, which added further importance to the role and established it as a clear second-in-command rather than just an afterthought.
sentences.zh: 这项修正案还允许总统在副总统职位空缺时进行任命，这进一步提升了副总统的作用，确立了其明确的二把手地位，而不再仅仅是个无足轻重的附庸。

sentences.en: By the time we reach the late 20th century, we see Vice Presidents taking on even more responsibility.
sentences.zh: 到了20世纪末，我们看到副总统承担了更多的责任。

sentences.en: The first VP to be given real responsibility was a man named Walter Mondale, who was Jimmy Carter’s VP.
sentences.zh: 第一位被赋予真正实权的副总统是一个叫Walter Mondale的人，他是Jimmy Carter的副总统。

sentences.en: He was given an office in the West Wing of the White House and was the first VP to really adopt the trusted advisor role, rather than honorary backup.
sentences.zh: 他的办公室被安排在白宫西翼，他是第一位真正扮演总统智囊角色，而不仅仅是虚位备胎的副总统。

sentences.en: It seemed, for once, that the President had understood that a powerful VP could be a great asset, not just to get elected but in the business of running the country.
sentences.zh: 看来，这一次总统终于明白，一个强有力的副总统不仅对赢得选举大有裨益，对治理国家也是宝贵的财富。

sentences.en: And moving into the early 21st century, Dick Cheney, who served as VP under George W.
sentences.zh: 进入21世纪初，在乔治·W·

sentences.en: Bush, took things up a notch. When he became VP he was a seasoned and influential politician, much more so than his running mate and boss, President George W.
sentences.zh: 布什手下担任副总统的Dick Cheney，把事情推向了更高的水平。当他成为副总统时，他是一位经验丰富、极具影响力的政治家，远比他的竞选搭档兼老板乔治·W·

sentences.en: Bush. He became involved in everything from foreign policy to energy strategy and is often referred to as the most powerful Vice President in history.
sentences.zh: 布什总统更资深。他参与了从外交政策到能源战略的方方面面，常被称为历史上最有权势的副总统。

sentences.en: For better or for worse, he reshaped the expectations of what a Vice President could do and laid the groundwork for future VPs to wield substantial power.
sentences.zh: 不管好坏，他重塑了人们对副总统职权范围的期望，并为后来的副总统掌握实权奠定了基础。

sentences.en: Most recently, as you will know, Kamala Harris was Joe Biden’s VP, and one of the criticisms levelled at her by her Republican opponents was that she was not a good VP, there were no major achievements that she could point at during her almost 4-years as Joe Biden’s number two.
sentences.zh: 最近大家也知道，Kamala Harris曾是Joe Biden的副总统，她受到共和党对手批评的一点是，她并不是一个合格的副总统，在她担任Joe Biden副手近四年的时间里，没有什么拿得出手的重大成就。

sentences.en: Now, her supporters would argue that this is not a fair assessment at all, and that she did a lot of important and necessary behind-the-scenes work, especially around things like women’s reproductive rights, healthcare and small business investment, and that she didn’t use her role as Vice President to promote herself, but rather to carry out her duties.
sentences.zh: 不过，她的支持者会反驳说，这种评价完全不公正，她在幕后做了很多重要且必要的工作，特别是在女性生育权利、医疗保健和小企业投资等方面，而且她没有利用副总统的角色来宣传自己，而是踏实履行职责。

sentences.en: After all, she was not expecting to be the Presidential nominee until very late in the day.
sentences.zh: 毕竟，直到很晚的时候，她都没有料到自己会成为总统候选人。

sentences.en: Joe Biden only dropped out in late July, so she had not much more than three months to convince the American public that she was up to the task of the top job.
sentences.zh: Joe Biden直到7月下旬才退选，所以她只有短短三个多月的时间来让美国公众相信她能胜任最高职位。

sentences.en: As you know, it did not work. Donald Trump was re-elected, and with him, JD Vance, a man who will be the third youngest Vice President in US history, and the youngest since 1953, when a 40-year-old Senator called Richard Nixon became Dwight Eisenhower’s VP.
sentences.zh: 如你所知，这并没有成功。Donald Trump重新当选，与他一同上台的还有JD Vance，他将是美国历史上第三年轻的副总统，也是自1953年以来最年轻的一位，当时40岁的参议员理查德·尼克松成为了德怀特·艾森豪威尔的副总统。

sentences.en: Richard Nixon went from Vice President to President, his Vice President, Gerald Ford, became President after Nixon was forced to resign, and since then George Bush Senior and Joe Biden have gone from the Vice Presidency to the Presidency.
sentences.zh: 理查德·尼克松从副总统升任总统，他的副总统杰拉尔德·福特在尼克松被迫辞职后接任总统，此后老乔治·布什和Joe Biden也都从副总统走向了总统宝座。

sentences.en: And this is not an anomaly. Out of the 46 individuals who have held the role of President, 15 of them were previously Vice Presidents.
sentences.zh: 这并不是什么反常现象。在担任过总统职务的46个人中，有15人此前曾担任过副总统。

sentences.en: Some, like Theodore Roosevelt, ascended to the presidency after a tragic assassination, while others, like George H.W.
sentences.zh: 其中一些人，比如西奥多·罗斯福，是在一场悲剧性的刺杀后登上总统宝座的；而另一些人，比如老乔治·H·W·

sentences.en: Bush, George Bush senior, were elected directly following their term as Vice President.
sentences.zh: 布什，也就是老布什，是在副总统任期结束后直接当选总统的。

sentences.en: This pathway is one of the most unique aspects of the Vice Presidency: while of course it’s not guaranteed, it provides a direct, often seamless route to the most powerful office in the land.
sentences.zh: 这条晋升路径是副总统职位最独特的方面之一：虽然这当然不是百分之百保证的，但它为通往国内最具权势的办公室提供了一条直接且通常很顺畅的途径。

sentences.en: And there is reason to believe that in the case of this President and this Vice President, the route is already being laid.
sentences.zh: 有理由相信，在这位总统和这位副总统身上，这条路已经铺好了。

sentences.en: Donald Trump became a household name with The Apprentice TV Series, where various young people compete to win a one-year contract working for Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: Donald Trump凭借电视真人秀节目《学徒》家喻户晓，节目中各种年轻人竞争赢得为Donald Trump工作一年的合同。

sentences.en: The idea was they would learn from a master dealmaker, and then be able to strike out on their own, if they so chose.
sentences.zh: 这个想法是，他们将向商业大师学习，如果他们愿意，随后就可以自立门户。

sentences.en: Trump cannot run for another term in office, so, in the public’s eye, it is his VP, JD Vance, who is his apprentice and natural successor.
sentences.zh: Trump不能再竞选一个总统任期了，所以在公众眼中，他的副总统JD Vance就是他的学徒和天然的接班人。

sentences.en: Just as candidates on ‘The Apprentice’ competed to learn from Trump and follow in his footsteps, JD Vance is seen as the political apprentice set to continue the movement that Trump started.
sentences.zh: 正如《学徒》节目中的候选人竞争向Trump学习并追随他的脚步一样，JD Vance被视为将延续Trump所发起的政治运动的政治学徒。

sentences.en: Young, ambitious, and with a loyal base, he has the opportunity to use this role to cement his position as the natural and appointed successor.
sentences.zh: 他年轻、雄心勃勃，拥有忠实的政治基础，这让他有机会利用这一角色巩固自己作为天然指定接班人的地位。

sentences.en: Politically, well you might believe he represents the dangerous and acceptable face of populism, you might believe he is a voice of common sense, but this isn’t a place to discuss his politics.
sentences.zh: 在政治上，你可能会认为他代表了危险且可以被接受的民粹主义面孔，你也可能会认为他是常识的声音，但这并不是讨论他的政治立场的地方。

sentences.en: He is undeniably ambitious, charismatic, well-connected, a confident public speaker, and with his own powerful story of overcoming poverty and abuse to achieve The American Dream.
sentences.zh: 不可否认的是，他雄心勃勃、富有个人魅力、人脉广泛、是一位自信的公众演说家，并且拥有战胜贫困与虐待、实现美国梦的励志故事。

sentences.en: And with a President who isn’t getting any younger, one who cannot run for President another time, and one who is keen to continue his political legacy, at least the betting markets are suggesting that Donald Trump might just have found his next apprentice.
sentences.zh: 鉴于现任总统日渐年迈、无法再次竞选总统，且急于延续其政治遗产，至少博彩市场表明，Donald Trump可能真的找到了他的下一个“学徒”。

sentences.en: OK then, that is it for today's episode on American Vice Presidents.
sentences.zh: 好了，这就是今天关于美国副总统节目的全部内容。

sentences.en: I hope it's been an interesting one, and that you've learnt something new.
sentences.zh: 希望这期节目对你们有所启发，也希望你们学到了新知识。

sentences.en: As always, I would love to know what you thought about this episode.
sentences.zh: 一如既往，我很想知道你们对这期节目的看法。

sentences.en: Had you heard of JD Vance before Donald Trump was elected?
sentences.zh: 在Donald Trump当选之前，你听说过JD Vance吗？

sentences.en: What do you think about him, and what do you think about his chances of becoming President in 2028?
sentences.zh: 你对他是怎么看的？你觉得他2028年竞选总统胜算如何？

sentences.en: I would love to know, so let’s get this discussion started.
sentences.zh: 我很想知道大家的想法，所以让我们开始讨论吧。

sentences.en: You can head right into our community forum, which is at community.leonardoenglish.com and get chatting away to other curious minds.
sentences.zh: 你可以直接登录我们的社区论坛 community.leonardoenglish.com，与其他求知欲旺盛的朋友们畅所欲言。

sentences.en: You've been listening to English Learning for Curious Minds, by Leonardo English.
sentences.zh: 你收听的是由Leonardo English制作的《English Learning for Curious Minds》。

sentences.en: I'm Alastair Budge, you stay safe, and I'll catch you in the next episode.
sentences.zh: 我是Alastair Budge，请注意安全，我们下期节目再见。
